items.mainDefect: String#scrub is called in poll_feed, but it does not exist on Ruby 2.0.0, which is the Ruby version the project's CI uses.

secondary.defect: SimpleRSS returns nil for content on RSS 2.0 items that only have a description, so i.content.scrub raises NoMethodError and aborts the import.

items.mainDefect: The embed url is interpolated unescaped into an href attribute in TopicEmbed.import, which allows XSS.

secondary.defect: Imported remote page and RSS HTML is stored and rendered as raw_html without sanitization, so javascript: links and other markup survive and cause stored XSS.

items.mainDefect: The retrieve throttle is keyed on the full embed_url, so an anonymous client can bypass it by changing the path or query string.

secondary.defect: Each RetrieveTopic job runs Jobs::PollFeed inline, so the whole feed is downloaded and every item imported on each request.
The remote fetch with open(url) has no read or open timeout, so it can block Sidekiq workers.
